description: Assessment is the independent validator's judgment of the milestone.

complete.description: Complete is true only after every claim in the requirements file was demonstrated in the running Storybook or web application.

observed.description: Observed states what the validator personally saw in the code, the checks, and the real browser.

unmet_claims.description: UnmetClaims lists each claim in the requirements file that was not demonstrated; use an empty list only when Complete is true.
